questions.question: A is thrice as good as workman as B and therefore is able to finish a job in 60 days less than B. Working together, they can do it in :
questions.explanation: A:B-এর কাজের হার 3:1। B-এর সময় 90 দিন, A-এর 30 দিন; একসঙ্গে 1/(1/30+1/90)=22.5 দিন।

questions.question: The organizers of a fair projected 25% increase of visitors this year over that of the last year but the actual turnover was 20% less than that of the last year. What percent of projected visitors attended the fair?
questions.explanation: actual = previous-এর 0.8 গুণ; projected = previous-এর 1.25 গুণ। অনুপাত actual/projected=0.8/1.25=0.64।

questions.question: Two planes leave the airport at the same time . Minutes later, plane A is 33 miles due north of the airport and plane B is 56 miles due east of the airport . How far apart are the two planes?
questions.explanation: দুই লম্ব বাহু 33 ও 56 হলে অতিভুজ √(33²+56²)=65।
